description: This file defines the ReadableManufacturer class, which extends ManufacturerEntity and includes a ManufacturerDescription. It provides getter and setter methods for the description property.

classes.name: ReadableManufacturer
classes.description: A Java class representing a readable manufacturer, extending ManufacturerEntity and implementing Serializable, with a description property.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the ManufacturerDescription for this manufacturer.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the ManufacturerDescription for this manufacturer.
